mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, parent_id, name, ancestors, sort_order, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dept WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY parent_id, sort_order, name
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET ancestors = #{newPrefix} || SUBSTRING(ancestors FROM LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1), updated_at = NOW() WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ancestors LIKE (#{oldPrefix} || '%')
